root.label: ICE officer fatally shot Lorenzo Salgado Araujo in Houston

events.label: ICE officer fatally shot Lorenzo Salgado Araujo in Houston

slots.name: years building homes
slots.sentence: A father of three U.S.-born children who spent 35 years building homes around the city, he was killed by an Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer during an operation aimed at another man .

slots.name: date of death
slots.sentence: Mr. Araujo was killed there during a traffic stop on July 7.
